newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia national wine centre gets A$20m funding.
newsitem.headline: Australia national wine centre gets A$20m funding.

text.p: Australia's proposed National Wine Centre in Adelaide has received a major boost, with the South Australian government announcing A$20 million in funding.
South Australia Premier John Olsen said the government also would apply to the federal government for matching finance from its newly-established Federation Fund.

The state government last month signed a memorandum of understanding with the Winemakers Federation of Australia confirming both parties' commitment to a world-class facility at the Hackney bus depot, the proposed historic inner city site near the Adelaide Botanic Gardens, he said.
Federation chief executive Ian Sutton said the centre would be the epicentre for wine tourism in Australia.
